bugs_found.description: Device status stays stolen after lockdown ACK instead of transitioning to locked
bugs_found.root_cause: Checkin handler read-modify-write race with ACK handler on Cloudflare KV. Checkin reads full devices array (with stale status=stolen), updates last_checkin, saves full array (overwriting ACK handler status=locked). Agent checks in every 30s when stolen, so the race repeats before KV propagates.
bugs_found.impact: Dashboard shows device as stolen instead of locked after lockdown. Operator confusion.
bugs_found.fix: Use per-device KV keys (device:{id}) instead of single devices array, OR separate checkin metadata (last_checkin) from device status into different KV keys, OR have checkin handler preserve status field by re-reading it right before save.
bugs_found.note: Unlock ACK status update (stolen->active) works because agent polls at 300s when active, giving KV time to propagate before next checkin.
